none: PAS NLM-EE81A1: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Keelby
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), urbs Roma issue of 330-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted and cuirassed bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins, two stars above. In exergue: TR.P. Diameter: 18.4mm, Weight: 1.79gms, die axis: 6
